items.title: Jon Jang interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 17, 2003 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are at Hamilton College filming for the Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have pianist and composer Jon Jang with me today... [INTERVIEWEE] Well thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: Jon was interviewed at Hamilton College on September 17, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are at Hamilton College filming for the Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have pianist and composer Jon Jang with me today, and welcome to Hamilton.
